iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ntohl
       Converts the unsigned integer from network byte order to host byte order.

SYNOPSIS
       ntohl NUMBER

DESCRIPTION
       Convert the unsigned integer from network byte order to host byte order.

       Syntax

       ntohl 

	    * Convert the unsigned integer from network byte order to host byte
	      order.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT, GLOBAL_GTM

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST{
	  set netlong 12345678
	  set hostlong [ntohl $netlong]
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.2 --First introduced the command.
